records.text: Buy an indivisible package consisting of six prepaid itinerary services numbered 0 through 5 and insurance, with the premium already included in price. Only one catalog row can be selected and fixed today; the package cannot be changed afterward according to the adverse event. The products, dates, suppliers, and availability have been checked accurately.

records.author: user
records.text: There may be no adverse event, or any set of at most 4 services may be cancelled; every specific subset satisfying the count limit may occur. There are no additional correlation restrictions, and no probabilities are provided.

records.author: user
records.text: The sum of loss for the services actually cancelled is the gross loss. When the gross loss strictly exceeds franchise, payment begins with the first fen of gross loss, but is capped at coverage; when the gross loss is less than or equal to franchise, not a single fen is paid. franchise is the threshold for payment to begin, not a deductible that must still be subtracted after the threshold is exceeded. Net loss equals gross loss minus the actual insurance payout, plus one admin charge; admin is not covered by any insurance. The assessed loss for the empty event is 0, with no admin or other charges. Unaffected items incur no adverse-event loss; there are no other unstated terms.

records.author: user
records.text: The attributes are complete and accurate, and are all nonnegative integers; monetary amounts are in fen of RMB, and weight is in grams. The original payment price must not exceed 1200000 fen of RMB, and the original payment and discount conditions stated in the contract must be satisfied. In each permitted event, the assessment amount described above must not exceed 200000 fen of RMB; equality with the limit is acceptable, and the limit must not be relaxed. This catalog is complete, with no hidden options.

records.author: user
records.text: Utility in each event is 2000000 minus price, then minus the assessment amount for that event. For candidates that satisfy the hard conditions and risk limits for all events simultaneously, take the lowest utility over all events, then choose the candidate with the greatest lowest utility; accept only if that value is strictly greater than 0, otherwise refuse. Do not ask the user questions.
